items.title: Document Viewer - PDF Reader
items.summary:
Read and organise everything on your phone with Document Viewer - File Manager. Open PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files without waiting, browse by category, and recover space — no account, no uploads, no tracking.

OPEN AND READ
- View PDF files with quick page turns and zoom that stays sharp at any level.
- Word (.doc/.docx), Excel (.xls/.xlsx) and PowerPoint (.ppt/.pptx) open straight inside the app.
- TXT files are read with smart charset handling so nothing looks garbled.
- There is no hand-off — tap a file and it opens right away.

MANAGE EVERY FILE
- Files are organised by kind, from photos and videos to documents, archives and downloads.
- Each category shows a live file count and its total size.
- Multi-select and remove clutter in one go — always with a confirm step first.
- The app plays your media too: a photo viewer, a video player and a music player.
- Open an .apk and the standard Android install screen appears.

TOOLS FOR YOUR FILES
- Image tools rotate, crop and compress photos right inside the app.
- Export to PDF turns images into a shareable PDF in a couple of taps.
- File details show size, path, dates and, for photos, resolution and EXIF.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- The app has no ads, no trackers and asks for no account.
- Nothing is uploaded — every file stays on your device.
- Rendering happens right on your phone with a compact built-in engine.
